parameters.name: GAINTYPE
parameters.help: The user may select RMS, MEAN, MAXIMUM or USER-SUPPLIED VALUES as a basis for TVS scalars.

parameters.name: POWR_EXP
parameters.help: This is the power exponent for adjusting computed gain scalars.  1.0=no extra adjustment, 0.5='softer' scaling.

parameters.name: USRP_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Primary User Value Header WORD
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the headers menu as the PRIMARY key for specifying TVS User supplied gain values.

parameters.name: USRS_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Secondary User Value Header WORD
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the headers menu as the SECONDARY key for specifying TVS User supplied gain values.

parameters.name: TVS_MODE
parameters.help: This option determines how the computed scalars will be applied to the trace samples.

choices.label: CENTER
choices.help: Interpolate and apply scalars from gate center to gate center.

choices.label: EDGE
choices.help: Apply a constant scalar within the gate and interpolate between gate edges.

parameters.name: MIN_SAMP
parameters.help: Minimum number of samples per TVS gate.  If fewer samples are available, the gate is removed.

parameters.name: db_option
parameters.prompt: Get TVS time gates from database?
parameters.help: Select 'YES' if the time gates were entered interactively.

parameters.name: GATENAME
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a TVS time gate parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: PRIM_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Primary Time Gate Header WORD
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the headers menu as the PRIMARY key for specifying TVS time gate parameters.

parameters.name: SCND_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Secondary Time Gate Header WORD
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the headers menu as the SECONDARY key for specifying TVS time gate parms.

parameters.name: OUT_TYPE
parameters.help: This option determines what values are in the output traces.

choices.label: SCALARS
choices.help: Output the scalar values as traces.
